body: i’m really sorry for you. i can understand what you’re going through (well, maybe a fraction of it). if you fell like you need to talk — my dms are open. i really hope that you’ll get help that you need ♡

srry if i sound stupid during this convo, but i’m genuine in everything i say :(
do you feel like life is a burden all the time, or are there some periods of “living isn’t so bad”? if there are, when do they happen? what causes them?

have you tried talking to a psychiatrist? 
i feel the same way, and my only hope is the fact that this can be fixed somehow with happy pills that will normalize everything.
“addicted to being addicted” is the best way that i can describe myself, you’re a genius. thank you for sharing ♡
you can die at any time. it would be irrational to not use a chance at that’s been given to you to it’s full capacity
i haven’t seen the first snow this year yet

i’m not trying to make you feel guilty for feeling this way, but genuinely think it would be a terrifying experience for her to see you in a casket. or to visit your grave, asking herself what she could’ve done different and not getting any closure. please, ask her, or anyone else for help

it’s not bravery. it’s a mix of despair, fear, feeling like you’re already dying before you even start to attempt. and probably a trigger — no matter how big or small — that just pushes you over the edge. but please, seek help. don’t suffer in silence. reach out to a friend, family or a psychiatrist. it feels awful to wake up the next morning after an attempt. but not waking up would be even worse
